why: The inserted binding prevented solitary prepositions/particles from being cut off from their objects, which reduced tiny, high-contradiction fragments and produced gains concentrated in the small latency bins (≤3: +0.0307, ≤5: +0.011); however it also forced merges across conjunctions/enumerations and shifted cuts into clause heads/verbs in longer contexts, producing the small negative effect at the sentence scale (≤99: −0.0112) and a substantial tail of worsened (but many also improved) pairs.
lesson: Keep lone prepositions/particles attached to their immediate complements to protect short fragments, but constrain that binding so it does not merge across longer enumerations or push cuts into clause heads, which harms whole-sentence cohesion.
